help_a1: Kindred remembers birthdays so you don't have to. Add a name and a date, and it tells you before the day arrives. That is all it does, and that is deliberate. Everything stays private to your account.
help_a2: Every birthday is announced on the morning of the day, at 09:00. The importance slider adds one earlier warning on top of that: three days ahead for medium, a week ahead for high. Reminders need notification permission to be switched on.
help_a3: Yes. The names and dates you add belong to your account alone and are never shared or shown to anyone else. Deleting your account removes all of it.
help_a4: Tap the + button on the main screen. A name, a day and a month is all that is required — the year is optional, and without it no age is shown or spoken.
help_a5: Settings, then Security, then Delete account at the bottom. After a two-step confirmation, your account and everything in it are permanently removed. This can't be undone.
help_a6: Try closing and reopening the app first. If it persists, use the feedback form below — describe what happened and we'll help.
